tool.name: nf-core pyrodigal
tool.description: Pyrodigal is a Python module that provides bindings to Prodigal, a fast, reliable protein-coding gene prediction for prokaryotic genomes.
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ pigz -cdf ${fasta} > pigz_fasta.fna
pyrodigal \\ -j ${task.cpus} \\ $args \\ -i pigz_fasta.fna \\ -f $output_format \\ -o "${prefix}.${output_format}" \\ -d ${prefix}.fna \\ -a ${prefix}.faa \\ -s ${prefix}.score
pigz -nmf ${prefix}*
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": pyrodigal: \$(echo \$(pyrodigal --version 2>&1 | sed 's/pyrodigal v//')) END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
Pyrodigal is a Python module that provides bindings to Prodigal, a fast, reliable protein-coding gene prediction for prokaryotic genomes.
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: pyrodigal Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
